contentItem.title: 等量关系：比例
contentItem.englishTitle: If a first magnitude have to a second the same ratio as a third has to a fourth, and also a fifth have to the second the same ratio as a sixth to the fourth, the first and fifth added together will have to the second the same ratio as the third and sixth have to the fourth.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: If a first magnitude have to a second the same ratio as a third has to a fourth, and also a fifth have to the second the same ratio as a sixth to the fourth, the first and fifth added together will have to the second the same ratio as the third and sixth have to the fourth.
如果一级与三级的比相同,一级与第三级的比相同,第二级的比与第二级的比相同,第二级和第五级的比相同,第一和第二级的比加在一起,第三和第四级的比相同。

Let a first magnitude AB have to a second C the same ratio as a third DE has to a fourth F; and let also a fifth BG have to the second C the same ratio as a sixth EH has to the fourth F; I say that the first and fifth added together, AG, will have to the second C the same ratio as the third and sixth, DH, has to the fourth F.
一级AB比第二C,与第三个DE比第四F;第五个BG比第二C比第六个EH比第四F;我说,第一和第二级加起来,AG比第二级C,与第三和第四级DH比。
For since, as BG is to C, so is EH to F, inversely, as C is to BG, so is F to EH.
BG比C等于EH比F,C比BG等于F比EH；BG 与 C 之比等于 EH 与 F 之比；C 与 BG 之比等于 F 与 EH 之比。
Since, then, as AB is to C, so is DE to F, and, as C is to BG, so is F to EH, therefore, ex aequali, as AB is to BG, so is DE to EH. [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]
从那时起,AB对C的比等于DE对F的比,C对BG的比等于F对EH的比,因此,从平等的角度讲,AB对BG的比等于DE对EH的比；AB 与 C 之比等于 DE 与 F 之比；C 与 BG 之比等于 F 与 EH 之比；AB 与 BG 之比等于 DE 与 EH 之比。 [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]
And, since the magnitudes are proportional separando, they will also be proportional componendo; [[V. 18](/principles/euclid-5-18)] therefore, as AG is to GB, so is DH to HE.
并且,由于星系是成比例 分比, 也将是成比例 合比。 因此,AG 和 GB 的比等于 DH 和 HE 的比；AG 与 GB 之比等于 DH 与 HE 之比。 [[V. 18](/principles/euclid-5-18)]
But also, as BG is to C, so is EH to F; therefore, ex aequali, as AG is to C, so is DH to F. [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]
但是,BG对C的比也等于EH对F的比;因此,从平等角度看,AG对C的比等于DH对F的比；BG 与 C 之比等于 EH 与 F 之比；AG 与 C 之比等于 DH 与 F 之比。 [[V. 22](/principles/euclid-5-22)]
